Dedicated Engineering Teams

Experienced engineers, dedicated to your roadmap.

Add engineering capacity without a long hiring cycle. Our engineers join your planning, your tools, and your delivery rhythm, and Coastline Digital stays accountable for quality and continuity.

Discuss Your ProjectHow we work

Capabilities

  • Team extension
  • Cross-functional pods
  • Technical leadership
  • Specialist capacity

What we deliver

Focused capabilities, delivered by experienced engineers.

  • Team extension

    Engineers who join your existing team and work in your repositories, ceremonies, and review process.

  • Cross-functional pods

    A small team covering the skills a workstream needs, such as backend, frontend, data, or AI, led by a senior engineer.

  • Technical leadership

    Senior engineers who can own architecture decisions, mentor developers, and keep delivery on track.

  • Specialist capacity

    AI, cloud, or data engineering expertise added for a specific initiative and released when it is complete.

When teams bring us in

Common starting points.

  • Your roadmap has outgrown your team’s capacity.
  • You need specialized skills for a defined period.
  • You want a stable team over time rather than rotating freelancers.
  • You run a consulting firm and need dependable delivery capacity. See engineering partnerships.

What you can expect

  • Named engineers with consistent assignment
  • Work in your tools, repositories, and processes
  • Agreed working-hour overlap with your team
  • Regular delivery and quality reviews
  • Continuity planning for handovers and time off

Our approach

From first conversation to production.

  1. 01

    Define needs

    Skills, seniority, working-hour overlap, and how the team will be managed day to day.

  2. 02

    Match and introduce

    We propose engineers for the role, and you can meet them before work begins.

  3. 03

    Onboard

    Access, environments, coding standards, and working agreements set up in the first days.

  4. 04

    Deliver and review

    Regular check-ins on delivery, quality, and fit, with adjustments as your needs change.

Questions

Common questions.

More answers on our FAQ page.

Where are your engineers located?

Coastline Digital is based in San Diego, CA, and works with an international team of engineering professionals. We tell you where each engineer is located and agree on working-hour overlap with your team before work starts.

How quickly can a team start?

It depends on the skills and seniority you need. After an initial conversation, we will give you a realistic estimate rather than a generic promise.

Can the team size change over time?

Yes. Team composition can be adjusted as your roadmap changes, within the notice terms of the agreement.
